name: session_event
description: FR-BB36 AC-4 -- ports tab_switch_events from c:\Users\tvolo\dev\ai-dala\BilimBaga\backend\migrations\015_session_tables.up.sql, PLUS ONE DELIBERATE ADDITION beyond the source schema. Product spec: corporate_exam_platform_roadmap.md section 3.6. READ THIS IN FULL BEFORE TREATING THIS AS A STRAIGHT PORT -- IT IS NOT ONE. NAMING: this entity type is named session_event, not tab_switch_event, and the reason rests entirely on the added event_type field below, NOT on any claim about what tab_switch_events itself stores: this entity records all three signal types service.go's ReportEvent accepts (tab_switch, blur, fullscreen_exit), only one of which is literally a tab switch, so tab_switch_event would be a narrower name than the entity's own contents warrant. The source table tab_switch_events stores none of the three signal-type strings -- see OMISSIONS below. THE SOURCE TABLE, VERBATIM (015_session_tables.up.sql AC-4 block): `id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), session_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), action_taken TEXT NOT NULL` -- exactly four columns, and event_type is not one of them. FIELD-LEVEL NOTES (the three ported fields). session_id is :string, queried: true, required: true, foreign_keys entry fk_session_event_session_id against session. occurred_at is :datetime, queried: true, required true (source DEFAULT NOW()) -- queried because a proctoring review needs to order and filter a session's events by time. action_taken is :enum with values log, warn, submit (source bare TEXT, but service.go's ReportEvent only ever writes one of these three, driven off the exam's on_tab_switch policy -- see the derivation note below). OMISSIONS. tab_switch_events has no event_type column, no id column is declared here (usual cross-subsystem reason), and no created_at/updated_at/created_by field is declared either. ADDITIONS -- event_type IS A DELIBERATE ADDITION TO THE SOURCE SCHEMA, NOT A PORT. event_type is :enum with values tab_switch, blur, fullscreen_exit, queried: false, required: true. The source VALIDATES this exact value and then THROWS IT AWAY: service.go:530's ReportEvent checks `!validEventTypes[input.Type]` against a validEventTypes map admitting exactly tab_switch, blur and fullscreen_exit, rejecting anything else with ErrInvalidEventType -- but the INSERT that follows, repository.go:705-709's InsertTabSwitchEvent, is `INSERT INTO tab_switch_events (session_id, occurred_at, action_taken) VALUES ($1, NOW(), $2)`, binding only session_id and action_taken; the eventType parameter passed into InsertTabSwitchEvent is never bound to anything and is dropped on the floor. After a session ends, the source's own data cannot distinguish an alt-tab from a fullscreen exit -- both leave identical rows differing only in whatever action_taken happened to be at that moment. Persisting event_type here anyway is the right call despite reproducing more than the source stores: the three signal types carry materially different evidentiary weight in a proctoring dispute (a candidate briefly alt-tabbing reads very differently from repeatedly exiting fullscreen), an integrity record that can only say WHAT ACTION WAS TAKEN but never WHAT THE CANDIDATE ACTUALLY DID is close to useless for the purpose this table exists to serve, and the column costs exactly one enum on a row that is already being written on every event. Reproducing the source's bug (discarding a value it already validated) is not fidelity; it is carrying forward a defect. Foreign keys: fk_session_event_session_id (field session_id, references_entity session). Indexes: idx_session_event_session_id over session_id, mirroring the source's idx_tab_switch_events_session_id. ENFORCEMENT NOTE, NOT SETTLED HERE: action_taken is DERIVED FROM THE EXAM'S on_tab_switch CONFIGURATION AND NEVER FROM THE REQUEST BODY -- service.go's ReportEvent, AC-10 (service.go:554-555, `action_taken is derived from the exam config, not the request body`), fetches the exam's on_tab_switch policy via GetExamConfig and passes cfg.OnTabSwitch, not any client-supplied field, into InsertTabSwitchEvent. This entity definition does not itself enforce that derivation -- it only declares the field shapes -- so this is stated here as a REQ-333 enforcement obligation on whichever write path implements ReportEvent's equivalent, and must not be read as permitting a client-supplied action_taken value at the record-write layer. ON DELETE: session_id's FK is CASCADE in the source and RESTRICT in Letflow (ddl.ex:675, decision 0025) -- a divergence, one of the five in the seven-row table in README-constraints.md. TIMESTAMPTZ: occurred_at was TIMESTAMPTZ in the source; ddl.ex:318 maps :datetime to timestamp(6) without time zone, dropping the offset -- recorded in README-constraints.md alongside session.expires_at and the other datetime columns.
